description: This file defines a PHP trait named NormalizerTrait within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods for normalizing data objects into arrays, ensuring model class validity, and handling collections of data for serialization purposes. The trait uses other project-specific traits and interfaces to facilitate object normalization in API responses.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the model being normalized.

methods.name: setModelClass
methods.description: Sets the model class name for normalization.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves the data to be normalized.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data to be normalized.

methods.name: normalizeObject
methods.description: Converts a single data object into an array representation, validating the model class.

methods.name: normalizeObjectsArray
methods.description: Converts an iterable collection of data objects into an array of array representations.

methods.name: checkForValidModelClass
methods.description: Verifies that the model class implements the Normalizable interface, throws exception if not.

methods.name: getInitializedModelInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the model class initialized with provided data.
